answer: The most convincing sybil defense is quorum sampling: every grading task is judged by a small random committee drawn only from long-established identities that have staked reputation, so a fresh fake account can never be selected no matter how many are forged. An attacker must either bridge value into years of honest history or corrupt living members, and each detected collusion burns the relic stake backing that identity, making mass fake identities far costlier than any fraud could earn.
